Class 11 Chemistry · States of Matter (gas laws)
Chemistry, visualised #5

For a fixed amount of gas, P × V ÷ T never changes.
Heat it with the lid locked, 300 K → 600 K: pressure × 2.
Hold 600 K and squeeze it to half: pressure × 2 again.
×2 × ×2 = ×4 → C. (Same reason a pressure cooker builds pressure as it heats.)
